# gtm_v1_user_permission (Data Source)

Gets a user's Account & Container Permissions.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) The GTM Account ID. The response value is returned in the same attribute.
- `permission_id` (String) The GTM User ID. The response value is returned in the same attribute.

### Read-Only

- `account_access_json` (String, Sensitive) GTM Account access permissions.
- `container_access_json` (String, Sensitive) GTM Container access permissions.
- `email_address` (String) User's email address.
